question: I am a read-only Viewer. Can I create an API credential for a reporting script?

response.answer: Yes, you can create an API credential for a reporting script as a read-only Viewer. First, confirm that your Role Assignment allows viewing of the API credentials. Next, ensure that the developer settings are accessible via the "Settings" menu within the Developer interface. Then, proceed to the "Developer" section on the left-hand side, navigate to "API Credentials," and select "Create New."
